description: This file is a C++ source file implementing Python bindings for the torch.distributed.rpc module, including initialization functions, class bindings, and RPC utility functions.

classes.name: RpcBackendOptions
classes.description: Class representing options for RPC backend configuration, including timeout and init method.

classes.name: WorkerInfo
classes.description: Structure encapsulating worker's name and ID in the distributed system.

classes.name: RpcAgent
classes.description: Class managing RPC communication, including methods for joining, syncing, shutting down, and retrieving worker info.

classes.name: PyRRef
classes.description: Class representing a remote reference to a value on a worker, with methods for serialization, type info, and autograd backward.

classes.name: TensorPipeRpcBackendOptions
classes.description: Class for configuring TensorPipe RPC backend options, including thread count, device maps, and devices.

classes.name: TensorPipeAgent
classes.description: Class implementing a TensorPipe-based RPC agent with methods for joining, shutdown, and worker info retrieval.

classes.name: RemoteProfilerManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing remote profiling keys and profiling state.
